title.narrative: The protected areas located in global high value ecosystems have access to readily accessible shortterm support to stave off and limit the effects of unexpected, urgent and critical threats to flagship wildlife species, biodiversity and local livelihoods.Those threats include: losses of protected areas revenues caused by global or local health / security crises; sudden surges in poaching and wildlife trafficking; insufficiently planned infrastructure developments, extractive industries and agroindustrial plantations; sudden deterioration of local economic conditions leading to increased human / wildlife conflicts; displaced persons
